specFidelityNotes: Issue #627 and ADR-046 Q4 are satisfied: one shop-scoped job per material trigger executes bounded targeted fetch to bronze append, current-row silver promotion, and gold shell hook in strict order. Webhook catalog id is propagated as enqueue_reason; Celery request id supplies per-trigger idempotency; logs contain only a hashed correlation id, enqueue_reason, and fetch-plan size. Orders integration covers the current bronze foundation. Full Fujiwa poll and A2 batch wiring are absent; unsupported future bronze domains are explicitly deferred.
